krishnaexplainsfivekarmas.title: Krishna Explains the Five Secrets of Karma

story_points.text: Arjuna, listen carefully to the secret truth of karma.
Life never remains the same at all times.
Even when people live righteously, suffering still comes.
Many people cry asking why they suffer despite doing good.
They see others doing wrong yet living comfortably.
This creates confusion, anger, and doubt in the mind.
This story is not just narration but a life guide.
It is wisdom given by Lord Krishna to Arjuna and to humanity.
Today we will learn the five deepest secrets of karma.
Knowing them gives power to change destiny.
Long ago, in the kingdom of Avanti, lived a merchant named Sudhama.
Sudhama was wealthy, honest, and kind by nature.
He never lied, cheated, or harmed anyone.
He never hurt even an ant knowingly.
Every morning he worshipped God.
He fed the poor before eating himself.
He had a wife and two children.
His life appeared peaceful and complete.
Suddenly, fate showed its cruel side.
One night, a massive fire broke out.
All Sudhama’s warehouses burned to ashes.
A lifetime of effort was destroyed in one night.
Soon after, his trusted partners betrayed him.
They cheated him and took his remaining wealth.
Sudhama was left with debts and nothing else.
Then another tragedy struck his life.
A deadly disease spread through the city.
Sudhama’s wife and children died.
He was completely alone.
People who once respected him now avoided him.
Some accused him of hidden sins.
They said God punished him for his karma.
Sudhama’s heart broke deeply.
Not for wealth, but for lost faith.
He questioned why God abandoned him.
Unable to bear the pain, he left the city.
He walked barefoot into the forest.
Hunger burned his body.
Pain burned his mind.
He collapsed under a banyan tree.
He cried to the sky questioning karma.
He questioned God’s existence.
Exhausted, Sudhama lost consciousness.
A cool divine breeze filled the forest.
A peaceful fragrance spread in the air.
Sudhama opened his eyes.
He saw a small fire glowing nearby.
A sage sat peacefully beside the fire.
Without opening his eyes, the sage called Sudhama by name.
The sage said he was waiting for him.
Sudhama was shocked and afraid.
He asked how the sage knew him.
The sage said he knew Sudhama’s pain and questions.
He invited Sudhama to sit and listen.
Sudhama angrily questioned the justice of karma.
The sage replied karma is not a business deal.
The sage explained Sanchita Karma.
It is the store of all past life actions.
The sage explained Prarabdha Karma.
It is the portion experienced in this life.
The sage explained Agami Karma.
It is created by present actions and reactions.
Prarabdha karma must be experienced.
But reactions decide future destiny.
First secret: Nishkama Karma.
Do duty without expecting results.
Second secret: Final thought at death.
Last thought shapes next birth.
The sage showed Sudhama his past life.
Sudhama died with hatred and revenge.
Third secret: Non-doership.
Ego creates bondage.
Seeing God as doer brings freedom.
Fourth secret: Dharma is subtle.
Intention matters more than action.
Sudhama was shown a future vision.
He saw himself raising a sword at a child.
The sage explained responsibility over emotion.
Sudhama faced his betrayer again.
Anger rose inside him.
The sage revealed past-life father connection.
Sudhama chose compassion over revenge.
Fifth secret: Complete surrender.
Love and surrender burn all karma.
In a temple, Sudhama saw a mirror.
He realized God exists within.
The sage revealed himself as Krishna.
Sudhama surrendered completely.
Sudhama attained inner liberation.
Krishna sent Sudhama back to serve society.
Sudhama entered a city without a king.
A divine elephant chose Sudhama as king.
Astrologers warned about a cursed child.
They demanded the child be killed.
Sudhama remembered Krishna’s teachings.
He rejected violence.
Sudhama embraced the child.
He prayed to take all suffering himself.
Dark poison entered Sudhama.
Divine surrender burned the poison.
The child was saved.
Destiny was rewritten.
A divine voice declared love conquers karma.
Sudhama ruled without ego.
The kingdom flourished.
Sudhama left his body peacefully.
He attained eternal liberation.
Everything is offered to Lord Krishna.
